purpose: Isolate translated comparison using identical reads and unchanged comprehensive core_nt, without NR
phases: Review completed runtimes and disagreements before selecting a larger fixed panel
invariants: Every method receives identical frozen FASTA bytes
Every method reads the same existing complete core_nt files
No reference restriction to viral hits or selected accessions
Every selected query retained in result denominator including no hits
No incomplete search interpreted as no-hit
Method-specific raw percent identity units and scores never compared directly
Runtime and exact source commit recorded before search

analysis.primary: Top10 distinct bitscores and at least90percent of best bitscore per mate after best HSP per query-subject; taxonomy per read, then paired evidence
analysis.secondary: Repeat assignment summaries restricting returned alignments to E<=1e-5; report changes, not an accuracy calibration
analysis.tblastx: Standard genetic code1 for both sides; default SEG and scoring; ungapped translated search; no nucleotide60percent identity restriction
analysis.controls: Synthetic synonymous-codon fixture verifies translation behavior, excluded from real-data counts
limits: Same reference isolates reference-content confounding, not all scoring/masking differences between algorithms
Six-frame standard-code translation does not cover every genetic code or frameshift
Aligned hit is evidence of similarity, not infection ground truth

budget.prior_NR_work: Separately authorized original experiment; do not extend or expand it under this new budget

history: Commit each method configuration before execution; store resulting source commit and input hashes; retain failed attempts
